title: Cover federation proof timeout, satellite install errors and invalid-timeout warnings
outcome: Cover federation proof timeout, satellite install errors and invalid-timeout warnings
acceptance: Tests pin S2 proof timeout as attestExpired/409 with a crypto count while startup/EOF transport failures remain uncounted.
Tests pin satellite-side proofRefused, linkDownBeforeProof, localInstallFailed preserving typed status and tagWriteExpired.
Tests verify a single redacted warning and default fallback for invalid or non-UTF-8 timeout configuration; production bounds are unchanged.
